kramer-chapel-ctsfw-fort-wayne-in-lcms.assessment: Kramer Chapel at Concordia Theological Seminary Fort Wayne — designed by Eero Saarinen (1958), notable architecture. Sister LCMS seminary to St. Louis, often regarded as more confessional in tone. Founded 1846 in Indiana.

score_notes.gender: Male-only pastors per LCMS Synodical practice
score_notes.cultural: LCMS officially holds traditional sexual ethics; rejects same-sex marriage; rejects female ordination
score_notes.preaching: Faculty preachers; CTSFW known for confessional rigor
score_notes.denominational: CTSFW historically the more confessional of the two LCMS seminaries

kramer-chapel-ctsfw-fort-wayne-in-lcms.services: Daily Matins and chapel during academic year
